#  <:announce:920051412329725982> SyncInk Ticket — Category Update is Live!

_We’re excited to roll out a major update to **SyncInk Ticket**, bringing fully customizable ticket categories, improved dashboard performance, better analytics, and more powerful activity tracking._

# <:syncclaimticket:1513812248957550683> What’s New with Categories?

_`Ticket panel categories` and `transfer categories` are now **fully customizable** directly from the [dashboard](https://syncink-ticket-bot.up.railway.app/)._

> <:topggDotPurple:921606879082315796><a:purplearrow:1360594346591912067>Add, remove, and edit categories
> <:topggDotPurple:921606879082315796><a:purplearrow:1360594346591912067>Use your own **custom emojis**
> <:topggDotPurple:921606879082315796><a:purplearrow:1360594346591912067>Supports both **animated and non-animated emojis**
> <:topggDotPurple:921606879082315796><a:purplearrow:1360594346591912067>Customize ticket and transfer options independently

# <a:endlessgears:609046319155380231> `How to Set It Up`<a:endlessgears:609046319155380231>﻿

#  <:syncinkvoicename:1517255773405577416>Ticket Categories

_To add, remove, or customize the categories displayed on your `ticket panel`:_

> **Dashboard `→` Ticket Categories**
> 🔗 [Open Ticket Categories](https://syncink-ticket-bot.up.railway.app/categories)

# <:sync_ticket_transfer:1513904436785971211>Transfer Categories

_To customize the options available when `transferring tickets`:_

> **Dashboard `→` Transfer Options**
> 🔗 [Open Transfer Options](https://syncink-ticket-bot.up.railway.app/transfer-options)

# <a:sparklestars:831911200073580635>`More Improvements in This Update`<a:sparklestars:831911200073580635>﻿

# <a:8422lightbluefireflames:1251513920821133313>Faster & More Stable Dashboard

> The dashboard has been optimized for improved **speed, responsiveness, and stability**, making configuration `smoother` and `more reliable.`

# <:IconStatusWebOnline:884924726814867457> Instant Online Transcripts

> When a ticket is closed, its transcript is now **instantly saved online** and made available through the dashboard for easier access and record keeping.

# <a:syncink_voice_alert:1518903037257846874>Ticket Analytics

> Get simple, useful charts powered by the same **live ticket records and activity history** used throughout the dashboard.

# <:syncink_admin:1518924309668823160>Dashboard Audit Logs

> Every configuration update is recorded, including **who made the change and what was changed**, giving server administrators better visibility without affecting the bot’s core systems.

# <:staff:314068430787706880>Staff Activity

> View your **top operators** based on recent ticket actions and get a clearer picture of staff activity.

# 📈Category Traffic

> See how ticket activity is distributed across your panel categories and identify which categories receive the most traffic.

# <:role_manager:1252322417863561357> Manage Your Ticket System

> <:IconStatusWebOnline:884924726814867457><a:purplearrow:1360594346591912067>**[SyncInk Ticket Dashboard](https://syncink-ticket-bot.up.railway.app)**
> Configure your categories, manage transfer options, review transcripts, monitor analytics, and customize your ticket system — all from one place.

**Thank you for using SyncInk Ticket.<:02kai_heart:1402490077426225253>**
<a:syncearthblurple:1519008181550842008> More improvements and features are on the way!

`— SyncInk Development Team`<:syncink:1529119144749043852>
author: sync_ink_001

# 🎉 **SyncInk Ticket Dashboard Update is Live!**

## 🚀 Major Dashboard Update

We're excited to announce that the **SyncInk Ticket Dashboard** has received a **major update** with numerous improvements, new customization options, and important bug fixes.

### ✨ What's New?

> 🛠️ Fixed various dashboard bugs and improved overall stability.
> 📂 You can now **customize your ticket category** directly from the dashboard.
> ⚡ Improved performance and a smoother user experience.
> 🎨 Enhanced interface with better customization options.
> 🔧 Multiple quality-of-life improvements and backend optimizations.

## 🌐 Dashboard

➡️ [SyncInk Ticket Dashboard](https://syncink-discord-ticketbot.up.railway.app/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 💜 We Need Your Feedback!

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for new features, please let us know in this server. Your feedback helps make **SyncInk** even better for everyone.

> Thank you for supporting **SyncInk**! 🚀✨
